description: Source code for an Odoo wizard module that generates third-party ledger reports with date and period filters.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: Defines a wizard interface for generating third-party ledger reports with date/period filtering.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Initializes default values for the report form, such as fiscal year, company, and periods.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines which report to generate based on user options.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that the selected date range falls within a fiscal year.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Validates the report state and ensures data availability.
